# Regency House Assisted Living (Hixson, Tennessee)

> Assisted living and respite care community with 48 private apartments at 2062 Hamill Road, Hixson, TN 37343, serving Hixson, Chattanooga, Red Bank, Soddy-Daisy and Signal Mountain. One inclusive monthly rate set by the apartment; no care levels; rates are quoted by phone, never published. Private pay; participants enrolled in PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) are welcome. Not a nursing home; no secure memory care unit. Tours daily by appointment: (423) 870-0050.
